study_meta.region_raw: Mainland China (outside Hubei province); 27 provincial and 264 urban health commissions
study_meta.population_raw: Confirmed COVID-19 cases linked in transmission chains; 1407 transmission pairs compiled, 677 with symptom-onset dates for both infector and infectee
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 677 transmission pairs (out of 1407 compiled); 9120 confirmed cases in source data
study_meta.method_raw: Normal distribution fitted to serial intervals using MCMC; serial interval computed as days between symptom-onset date of infector and infectee; running time windows of 10, 14, 18 days; stratification by household, isolation delay, age, gender
